arithmetic: scaled integers at 12 decimal places; see backend/app/money.py and frontend/src/lib/money.ts
rounding: half away from zero; money and percentages quantised to 2 decimal places
exact_money_limit: 9007199254740991/100. Above this magnitude a JSON number cannot hold two decimal places; both sides still agree exactly, but the minor unit is not meaningful.
input_precision: a numeric input is read from its shortest round-tripping decimal form and rounded half away from zero to 12 decimal places
note: Shared decision contract. backend/tests/redesign/test_contract_parity.py and frontend/src/lib/economics.contract.test.ts must both reproduce every case exactly.
